description: This Java source file defines the DittoLoggerFactory class, a factory for creating various types of loggers and logging adapters used within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for Akka actors and SLF4J logging.

classes.name: DittoLoggerFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to obtain different types of loggers and logging adapters for Akka actors and SLF4J.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a DittoLogger instance named after the provided class, using SLF4J LoggerFactory.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a DittoLogger instance named after the provided string name, using SLF4J LoggerFactory.

methods.name: getThreadSafeLogger
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe DittoLogger instance named after the provided class.

methods.name: getThreadSafeLogger
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe DittoLogger instance named after the provided string name.

methods.name: getDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
methods.description: Creates a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter with MDC support for the given Akka Actor.

methods.name: getThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe logging adapter with MDC support for the given Actor.

methods.name: getActorClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of the actor from its Props.

methods.name: getDiagnosticLoggingAdapterFactory
methods.description: Creates a Supplier that produces DiagnosticLoggingAdapter instances for a given Actor.
